A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LrcSSM research and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–E. Full text and rendered-page comparison identifies differences only on pages 1 and 14.

before.justification: v5 reports original LrcSSM classification results, runtime measurements, PPG-DaLiA results, and ablations in Section 5 and Appendices B, C, and E.

after.justification: v6 retains those original classification, runtime, PPG-DaLiA, and ablation results.

M1.justification: The LrcSSM architecture, diagonal-Jacobian construction, update equations, and parallelization procedure are unchanged. Appendix D's generalized construction and GRU example are also identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six UEA classification datasets and the PPG-DaLiA task in Appendix C. No training or evaluation coverage changes.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same eleven baselines; Table 2 retains MguSSM, GruSSM, and LstmSSM. Comparator membership in the appendix experiments is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The data splits, metrics, hyperparameter search, fixed configurations for supplementary experiments, and Euler timestep remain unchanged in Section 5 and Appendices B–E.

E4.justification: Appendix E retains identical capacitance, dense-versus-diagonal Jacobian, input/state dependency, and real-versus-complex parameter ablations. The convergence-iteration analysis in Appendix B.5 is unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same five-split/seed information and standard deviation and standard error reporting conventions. No uncertainty estimation or repeated-run information changes.

E6.justification: All empirical results and plots are unchanged, including LrcSSM's 66.3 ± 8.3% average in Table 1 and 10.89 ± 0.96 PPG-DaLiA entry in Table 7. Table 3's changed memory bound is a theoretical complexity correction.

T1.justification: Table 3 changes LrcSSM's memory complexity from O(D) to O(TD), aligning the formal summary with the existing abstract, Section 3.4, and Appendix A.2. The stability assumptions, lemma, theorem, proofs, and Appendix D derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The central claims about parallelization, gradient stability, generalization, and benchmark performance are retained. The abstract replaces 'time' with 'computational work' while preserving the existing O(TD) bound and O(log T) sequential depth.

C2.justification: The interpretations of performance, integration schemes, and diagonal simplification are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitation concerning the additional Newton iterations.

D1.justification: Hardware, training times, hyperparameters, integration details, and code/data access information are unchanged. The arXiv hyperlink merely updates its version identifier.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to linear SSMs, DEER, ELK, and liquid networks are unchanged. The expanded title emphasizes an already established focus.

P1.justification: v6 prefixes the title with 'Parallelization of Non-linear State-Space Models:', adds Daniela Rus's Liquid AI affiliation, and clarifies 'time' as 'computational work' in the abstract. Section organization and remaining prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer title adds a line and shifts the author block, abstract, and introduction on page 1. Figures and table structures are unchanged; Table 3 only changes its memory-complexity entry.

improvement.justification: v6 resolves Table 3's contradiction with the existing O(TD) memory discussion and clarifies computational work versus sequential depth in the abstract. These provide limited improvements in accuracy and internal consistency, while the experimental evidence and substantive conclusions remain unchanged.
